Build the airGR inputs and run options once per basin

Source: R/gr.R
gr_setup.Rd

Build the airGR inputs and run options once per basin

Usage

gr_setup(daily, pet, hypso, z_inputs, n_layers = 5, model = "GR4J")

Arguments

daily

Gap-free daily tibble with date, prcp_mm, tmean_c, tmin_c, tmax_c.

pet

Daily potential evaporation (mm), aligned with daily.

hypso

101 elevation quantiles (get_basin_hypsometry()).

z_inputs

Elevation the forcing represents (basin-mean elevation for basin-mean GridMET).

n_layers

CemaNeige elevation bands.

model

"GR4J", "GR5J" or "GR6J".

Value

list(model, inputs, run_options) for gr_run().
